candidates.change_summary: Replace acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) with acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) so Put decreases balance instead of increasing it.
Replace acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp with acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp so unlockTime is always set to current block timestamp, ignoring the parameter.
Delete acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) so Put never updates the balance, only unlockTime and log.
Replace acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) with acc.balance = msg.value so balance is set to the sent amount instead of incrementing it.
Replace acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp with acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime so unlockTime is always set to the passed parameter even if it is in the past.
Remove nonReentrant_ modifier from Put to allow reentrant calls that could manipulate balance/unlockTime during execution.
Remove locked_ = true; from the modifier, breaking the reentrancy lock so nested calls can re-enter.
Remove locked_ = false; from the modifier so once entered the lock never releases, making all subsequent calls revert.
Remove the unlock time check so Collect succeeds regardless of block.timestamp
Change the balance deduction to add instead of subtract, increasing the balance on collect
Remove the require that _am <= acc.balance, allowing over-withdrawal that changes the final balance
Remove the reentrancy guard unlock so a reentrant call can re-enter Collect and change the balance multiple times
